originalInput.name: Urban birds review
originalInput.question: Which empirical field studies concern urban birds?

criteria.label: Species and setting
criteria.include: Bird populations nesting in urban city parks and gardens.
criteria.exclude: Marine fish populations swimming in ocean coral reefs.

criteria.label: Evidence type
criteria.include: Empirical field study collecting measurements and observations of wild animals outdoors.
criteria.exclude: Theoretical mathematical simulation using computer models without field observations or collected measurements.

papers.title: Park nesting census
papers.text: An empirical field study collected outdoor observations and measurements of wild bird populations nesting in urban city parks.

papers.title: Simulated city nests
papers.text: A theoretical mathematical simulation used computer models of bird populations nesting in urban city gardens without field observations or collected measurements.
